### Packages
```{r}
#install.packages("tidyverse")
library(tidyverse)
tidyverse_packages()


```
## Import data

```{r}
read.csv(file = "data/penguin_dataset.csv" )
penguins <- read.csv(file = "data/penguin_dataset.csv" )
```

## Data wrangling


```{r}
penguins |> count(island) |> arrange(n)

penguins |> relocate(year, .after = island) |> head()

penguins |> arrange (body_mass)
penguins |> arrange(desc(flipper_len)) |> head()
penguins |> arrange(species, bill_len)
penguins |> relocate(island, .after = body_mass) |> head()
penguins |> arrange(desc(body_mass)) |> relocate(island, .after = body_mass) |> head()

##filtering in single criteria and combinations
penguins |> filter(body_mass > 3000) |> head()
penguins |> filter(body_mass > 4000) |> count()
penguins |> filter(body_mass > 4000) |> distinct(island)

##filtering with and/or
penguins |> filter(species == "Gentoo" & bill_len > 30) |> count()
penguins |> filter(species == "Gentoo" | island == "Biscoe") |> count()

penguins |> filter(species ==  "Adelie") |> count()
penguins |> count(island)
penguins |> filter(species == "Gentoo" & body_mass > 5000)
penguins |> filter(sex == "male" | sex == "female") |> count()
penguins |> filter(body_mass < 3500 | bill_len < "35") |> count()
```
